stem.en: The word bank appears in "The boat reached the river bank" and in "Amma went to the bank". After attention, what is different between the two sentences?

text.en: Bank has a different working copy in each one
Some settings were nudged to suit each sentence
The embedding table now has two embeddings for bank
Bank has been given a new token id each time

explanation.en: Attention mixes numbers from the words around bank into a working copy, so river and Amma lead to different copies. The embedding table, the token id and the settings all stay as they were, because a nudge happens only in training.
